# Brief template (10 lines max)

Fill in what is known. Mark guesses as assumptions instead of asking.

```
Assumptions: (each one can be flipped by the user in one line)
- ...

| Item | Content |
| --- | --- |
| User and role | who uses it, with what permission |
| Tasks (1-3) | what must be finished on this screen |
| Context | device, environment, frequency, cost of an error |
| Current problem | observed facts, separate from guesses; what the request assumes that the code lacks |
| Constraints | existing system, technology, policy, deadline; anything the request needs that `DESIGN.md` forbids (decision first) |
| Success criteria | measurable: steps, errors, time |
| Tone | two words at most (calm, precise, friendly) |
| Out of scope | behaviour, permissions, data flow that must not change; for a redesign also what the contract fixes (areas, flow, wording) |
| Open questions | blocking only, 3 at most |
```

Ask a question only if the answer changes an irreversible decision, two requirements conflict, or there is no data to design from.
